title: "read_in_bam"
output: html_document

```{r A}
library(tidyverse)
build_reads_per_umi_count_df <- function(
    bam_fpath,
    library,
    set_bin_name_to,
    set_sample_to,
    chunk_size = 10000000L,
    consolidate_every = 10L
    ) {

    sgrna_list <- library$sgrna_seq
    n_sgrnas <- length(sgrna_list)

    bam <- Rsamtools::BamFile(bam_fpath, yieldSize = chunk_size)

    open(bam)
    on.exit(close(bam), add = TRUE)

    chunk_results <- list()
    chunks_since_consolidation <- 0L
    chunk_number <- 0L
    reads_processed <- 0L

    memory_used_gb <- function() {
        gc()[2, 2] / 1024
    }

    memory_rss_gb <- function() {
        status <- readLines("/proc/self/status")
        rss_line <- status[startsWith(status, "VmRSS:")]
        as.numeric(sub("VmRSS:\\s+([0-9]+) kB.*", "\\1", rss_line)) / 1024^2
    }

    repeat {

        chunk_start <- Sys.time()

        reads <- Rsamtools::scanBam(
            bam,
            param = Rsamtools::ScanBamParam(
                flag = Rsamtools::scanBamFlag(
                    isSecondMateRead = FALSE
                ),
                what = character(),
                tag = c("CB", "UB")
            )
        )[[1]]

        if (length(reads$tag$CB) == 0L) { break }

        chunk_number <- chunk_number + 1L
        chunks_since_consolidation <- chunks_since_consolidation + 1L
        reads_processed <- reads_processed + length(reads$tag$CB)

        sgRNA <- reads$tag$CB
        UMI <- reads$tag$UB

        keep <- !is.na(sgRNA) & !is.na(UMI)

        if (any(keep)) {

            sgRNA <- sgRNA[keep]
            UMI <- UMI[keep]

            sgRNA_id <- match(sgRNA, sgrna_list)

            keep_library_sgrna <- !is.na(sgRNA_id)

            if (any(keep_library_sgrna)) {

                sgRNA_id <- sgRNA_id[keep_library_sgrna]
                UMI <- UMI[keep_library_sgrna]

                umi_values <- unique(UMI)
                UMI_id <- match(UMI, umi_values)

                pair_key <- as.double(sgRNA_id) +
                    as.double(n_sgrnas) * (as.double(UMI_id) - 1)

                ordered_key <- sort(pair_key)
                runs <- rle(ordered_key)

                unique_keys <- runs$values

                # Inverse of the 1-based pair key encoding.
                sgRNA_id <- ((unique_keys - 1) %% n_sgrnas) + 1L
                umi_id <- floor((unique_keys - 1) / n_sgrnas) + 1L

                chunk_results[[length(chunk_results) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
                    sgRNA = sgrna_list[sgRNA_id],
                    UMI = umi_values[umi_id],
                    count = runs$lengths,
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                )
            }
        }

        if (chunks_since_consolidation >= consolidate_every) {

            if (length(chunk_results) > 0L) {
                chunk_results <- list(
                    dplyr::bind_rows(chunk_results) %>%
                        dplyr::group_by(sgRNA, UMI) %>%
                        dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
                )
            }

            chunks_since_consolidation <- 0L
        }

        chunk_time <- as.numeric(
            difftime(Sys.time(), chunk_start, units = "secs")
        )

        cat(
            "Finished chunk", chunk_number,
            "| reads:", format(reads_processed, big.mark = ","),
            "| time:", sprintf("%.2f s", chunk_time),
            "| R memory:", sprintf("%.2f GB", memory_used_gb()),
            "| RSS:", sprintf("%.2f GB", memory_rss_gb()),
            "\n"
        )
    }


    if (length(chunk_results) == 0L) {
        result <- data.frame(
            sgRNA = character(),
            UMI = character(),
            count = integer(),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    } else {
        result <- dplyr::bind_rows(chunk_results) %>%
            dplyr::group_by(sgRNA, UMI) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
    }
    
    # Modify it to be in line with count_df_long formating
    return(
        result %>%
            left_join(
                library %>%
                    select(-any_of(c("align_seq", "gene", "entrez_id"))),
                by = c("sgRNA" = "sgrna_seq")
            ) %>%
            rename(
                sgrna_seq = sgRNA,
                sgRNA = sgrna_id,
                group_category = type
            ) %>%
            mutate(
                bin_name = set_bin_name_to,
                sample = set_sample_to,
                sublib = sgrna_seq,
                exp = paste(sublib, sample, sep = "_")
            ) %>%
            select(-sgrna_seq) %>%
            select(c(sgRNA, sublib, bin_name, count, group_category, sample, exp))
    )

}
```

```{r B}
library <- readRDS("/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis/library/CM_specific_library.rds")
duplicated_library <- library %>%
    dplyr::group_by(sgrna_seq) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

dual_rep_dir <- "/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis/HepG2_dual_rep/"
all_conjugates_overlap_classified <- readRDS(file.path(dual_rep_dir, "all_conjugates_overlap_classified.rds"))

dups_in_hits <- duplicated_library %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% manual_add_for_missing$`Target Gene Symbol`)
dups_in_list <- readRDS("/g/steinmetz/link/Gene_list_finalize/cp_sgRNA_df_alias_re.rds") %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% duplicated_library$gene)
cp_sgRNA_df_RAW_dups <- cp_sgRNA_df_RAW %>% 
  dplyr::filter(`Target Gene Symbol` %in% duplicated_library$gene)
pa_maude_hits_df <- readxl::read_xlsx(
    "/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis/HepG2_dual_rep_PA/results/MAUDE_Hits_lukas_reads_control_median_RI_comb_sample.xlsx"
)
jia_count_df <- readRDS("/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis/Jia_CM_prelim/rds/count_df.rds")
expression_of_dups <- pa_maude_hits_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(symbol %in% duplicated_library$gene)

subset_reads_per_umi_dups <- reads_per_umi_count_df %>% 
  filter(sgRNA %in% duplicated_library$sgrna_id)
# Number of occurrences of each gene in duplicated_library
gene_frequency <- duplicated_library %>%
    dplyr::count(gene, name = "n_occurrences")

# Define overlap groups for each sgRNA sequence
sgrna_groups <- duplicated_library %>%
    dplyr::group_by(sgrna_seq) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
        n_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(gene),
        genes = paste(sort(unique(gene)), collapse = " / "),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        color_group = dplyr::if_else(
            n_genes == 1,
            "no-overlap",
            genes
        )
    )

# Map each gene to its overlap group
gene_colors <- duplicated_library %>%
    dplyr::select(sgrna_seq, gene) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
        sgrna_groups %>%
            dplyr::select(sgrna_seq, color_group),
        by = "sgrna_seq"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, color_group) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

# Build plotting dataframe
plot_df <- expression_of_dups %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
        gene_frequency,
        by = c("symbol" = "gene")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
        gene_colors,
        by = c("symbol" = "gene")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        label = dplyr::if_else(
            cardio_IPSC_TPM >= 20 | cardio_primary_TPM >= 10,
            dplyr::if_else(
                color_group == "no-overlap",
                symbol,
                color_group
            ),
            NA_character_
        )
    )

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)


p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
        x = cardio_IPSC_TPM,
        y = cardio_primary_TPM,
        size = n_occurrences,
        shape = factor(n_occurrences),
        colour = color_group
    )
) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        aes(label = label),
        na.rm = TRUE,
        size = 3,
        force = 10,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
        breaks = 1:4,
        range = c(2, 8),
        name = "Reduction in unique guides per gene(s)"
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
        values = c(
          "1" = 16,  # circle
          "2" = 17,  # triangle
          "3" = 15,  # square
          "4" = 16   # diamond
        ),
        name = "Reduction in unique guides per gene(s)"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
        values = c(
            "no-overlap" = "black",
            setNames(
                scales::hue_pal()(
                    length(setdiff(unique(plot_df$color_group), "no-overlap"))
                ),
                setdiff(unique(plot_df$color_group), "no-overlap")
            )
        )
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Cardio iPSC TPM",
        y = "Cardio primary TPM",
        colour = "sgRNA overlap group"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = "right"
    )

ggsave(
    "/g/steinmetz/link/sharing/Novartis/expression_duplicated_guides.png",
    p,
    width = 12,
    height = 12,
    units = "in",
    limitsize = FALSE
)
writexl::write_xlsx(duplicated_library, "/g/steinmetz/link/sharing/Novartis/guides_duplicated_in_CM_library.xlsx")
```

```{r add_origin_of_gene}
panglao_markers <- read.delim(
    "/g/steinmetz/link/Gene_list_finalize/check_where_stuff_is_from/PanglaoDB_markers_27_Mar_2020.tsv",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
) %>% rename(gene = `official gene symbol`)

doench_kinase <- readxl::read_xlsx(
    "/g/steinmetz/link/Gene_list_finalize/check_where_stuff_is_from/doench_kinase.xlsx"
) %>% rename(gene = `Target Gene Symbol`)

morgens_membrane <- readxl::read_xlsx(
    "/g/steinmetz/link/Gene_list_finalize/check_where_stuff_is_from/morgens_membrane.xlsx",
    sheet = "Guide sequences",
    col_names = c("guide_name", "seq")
) %>%
    tidyr::separate(
        guide_name,
        into = paste0("V", 1:10),
        sep = "_",
        fill = "right",
        extra = "merge"
    ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(V3 == "MEPR", V2 != "safe", V2 != "none") %>% 
  rename(gene = V2) %>% 
  select(V1, gene, seq)

duplicated_library <- duplicated_library %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        added_because = purrr::map_chr(
            gene,
            ~ {
                reasons <- character()

                if (.x %in% morgens_membrane$gene) reasons <- c(reasons, "Membrane")
                if (.x %in% doench_kinase$gene) reasons <- c(reasons, "Kinase")
                if (.x %in% panglao_markers$gene) reasons <- c(reasons, "CM_marker")

                if (length(reasons) == 0) {
                    "Overlap_xie_churko_galdos"
                } else {
                    paste(reasons, collapse = ";")
                }
            }
        )
    )
```

```{r}
count_99 <- quantile(reads_per_umi_count_df$count, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(
    dplyr::filter(reads_per_umi_count_df, count <= count_99),
    aes(x = count)
) +
    geom_histogram(
        aes(y = after_stat(count / sum(count) * 100)),
        binwidth = 2,
        boundary = 1, 
        closed = "left"
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Reads per sgRNA-UMI combination",
        y = "Percentage of sgRNA-UMI combinations (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

clone_counts <- reads_per_umi_count_df %>%
    dplyr::count(sgRNA, name = "n_clones")

ggplot(clone_counts, aes(x = n_clones)) +
    geom_density() +
    labs(
        x = "Number of clones per sgRNA",
        y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
```
